messages:
sasha: Kicking off our region-by-region rollout for service v3.4.1. Plan: US -> EU -> APAC, staggered by ~20m slices. Change window 01:00-04:00 UTC. Canary = 5% traffic, warm pool reserved = 15% of capacity per region. Pin fallback to v3.4.0 available.
deploy-bot: [automated] deploy request accepted for v3.4.1. Initiating canary in us-west-2 (slice 1). Preserving warm pool 15%. Will announce canary-health after warmup.
kevin: Quick capacity snapshot for us-west-2 before canary: GPU pool available nodes = 48, reserved nodes for warm pool = 8, current avg GPU util = 62%, queued requests (last 5m) = 120. Should be safe for 5% canary.
maria: Oncall checking perf during warmup. I'll watch 95p latency and error rate. If 95p > 280ms or error rate > 1.2% for 3 consecutive mins, we pause.
andrew: Product note: we've got three VIP customers in US with heavier tail. Recommend we pin their routes to dedicated pool for the first 2 slices. Sasha, ok to do that?
sasha: Yes—pin vip-* routes to dedicated-dc-us for first 40m. We'll remove pins once baseline looks stable. Rollback criteria: error rate >2% sustained 2 mins OR 95p latency increase >30% vs baseline OR token-cost-per-request spikes >40% for 3 mins. On any trigger, immediate canary pause + route traffic to v3.4.0 pinned instances.
kevin: Added automated circuit-breaker thresholds into routing rules: queue depth threshold = 2000 tokens, GPU util threshold = 90%, tail-latency = 350ms. If any threshold tripped, rollout engine will divert to fallback and notify this channel.
maria: Seeing first warmup logs. P95 = 210ms, errors = 0.3%, throughput steady. Posting a quick snippet: ```
[us-west-2] warmup: requests=1200, success=1196, errors=4, p50=85ms, p95=210ms, gpu_util=64%
```
sasha: Good. After the 10min warmup we'll open canary traffic to 5%. Keep an eye on JV replica memory growth—one of the regressions last week was an unexpected mem leak on long contexts.
deploy-bot: [automated] us-west-2 canary opened to 5% traffic at 01:12 UTC. Monitoring: latency, errors, queue depth, cost-delta. Next scheduled slice: eu-west-1 warmup @ 01:32 UTC.
andrew: For EU we should lower warm pool to 12% because of capacity variability in eu-west-1. Also note compliance telemetry will be switched on for EU slices; slight perf hit expected.
kevin: Noted. eu-west-1 precheck: nodes available = 30, reserved warm pool set to 12% => 4 nodes, current avg util 55%. I'll set a slightly longer warmup (12m) for EU and enable perf sampling.
maria: us-west-2 canary metrics after 8m: p95=225ms (baseline 210ms), errors=0.5% (baseline 0.3%), no memory growth observed. Still within warning band. No action.
sasha: Decision tree reminder for escalations: 1) Warning band (p95 +10% or errors up to 1.5%) -> ops watch and extend warmup. 2) Alert band (p95 +25% or errors >2%) -> pause canary, pin to previous version, notify customers and SRE. 3) Critical (sustained resource exhaustion / queuing) -> immediate rollback and page SRE.
kevin: deploy-bot will also enforce a hard inter-slice gap of 15m if the previous slice required any manual intervention. I'll enable that for this rollout.
maria: No manual interventions so far. Scheduling EU warmup now. I'll hand off monitoring to europe-oncall for the canary open.
deploy-bot: [automated] eu-west-1 warmup started at 01:32 UTC. Canary scheduled to open at 01:44 UTC if health checks pass.
andrew: Flagging: APAC has patch windows later tonight; we should avoid heavy changes there during partner maintenance at 03:00 local. Plan to delay APAC main rollout by +30m if necessary.
sasha: Acknowledged. We will gate APAC until EU is green and US steady for 30m. If EU has any alert-band hits, APAC is paused automatically.
maria: Final note — runbook update: added step to escalate to dedicated capacity owners before rollback for customers pinned to dedicated pools. Means we'll verify fallback capacity before triggering org-wide rollback.
sasha: Thanks everyone. If no alerts in next 20m, proceed with sequential expansion to eu-canary then apac warmup. I'll post a final status update when we flip EU canary.
deploy-bot: [automated] eu-canary opened to 5% at 01:45 UTC. Monitoring has green for initial 5 minutes.
